Why does Vaillant say "untested"?

The Vaillant connection is built after the actively maintained reference signalkraft/myPyllant and has been confirmed on two real systems by testers (controllers tli and vrc700). It is read-only by design (no control commands). The manufacturer's energy interface has a limited quota and is therefore queried only every four hours. Feedback (including errors) is welcome in the WPHub forum thread.
Credentials are only used for the one-time login and are not stored afterwards -- only the resulting access key is kept.
Is the storage of the credentials safe?

popup.caption: Is the storage of the credentials safe?

items.caption: Symcon does NOT encrypt attributes at rest. "Safe" here means: not visible in the form or log -- no real encryption. The password is only used for the one-time login and cleared automatically afterwards; only the access key (token) is kept. Accounts with two-factor authentication (2FA) are not supported yet.

When do I need "Accept updated terms"?

popup.caption: When do I need "Accept updated terms"?

items.caption: After updates of the terms of use or the privacy policy Panasonic requires the account to agree again (cloud error code 4103, instance status "Agreement required") -- just like on the next start of the official app. This button confirms both on behalf of your account; WPHub deliberately NEVER does this automatically. The texts themselves are in the official app or on panasonic.com. Alternatively: open the official Comfort Cloud app once and confirm there.

What is the app version field for?

popup.caption: What is the app version field for?

items.caption: The Comfort Cloud rejects requests from outdated app versions (error code 4106). WPHub then determines the current version number of the official app itself (Play Store, AppBrain as fallback) and keeps using it automatically. This field is only a fallback in case the automatic detection fails: then enter the version number from the Play Store/App Store here and apply. A version determined automatically takes precedence over this field.

The Comfort Cloud provides no real power/energy and no flow/return/buffer temperature. Here you can optionally link any existing Symcon variable (e.g. a Shelly, MeterHub, your own sensor) -- WPHub then reports the value as a real measurement in the family contract instead of leaving it empty. If a meter in MeterHub is marked with the function assignment "Heat pump", WPHub suggests it here automatically.
What are external sensors & meters good for?

popup.caption: What are external sensors & meters good for?

items.caption: WPHub does not need any particular other module for this -- any Symcon variable works (Shelly instance, MeterHub, HeishaMon, your own 1-wire sensor). Linked values appear as a real measurement in the family contract (WPHUB_GetFunctions) and are shown e.g. in the system diagram. No COP/seasonal performance calculation: WPHub structurally lacks the heat output for it (no flow rate, no water volume), which cannot be derived even with an electricity meter.
